PR Summary by Qodo

Replace retired Gemini PDF-reading default 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests ⚙️ Configuration changes 🕐 10-20 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Replace the retired PDF-reading fallback with gemini-3.8-flash to restore default PDF reading.
>• Align WebStarter’s PDF setting and Google AI model pricing with the new default.
>• Add a unit test that guards the fallback provider and model.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD A["PDF settings"] --> B{"Provider and model?"} B -->|Yes| C["Configured model"] --> E["Chat completion"] --> F["Provider API"] B -->|No| D["Gemini 3.8 fallback"] --> E ```
High-Level Assessment

>Updating both the code fallback and sample configuration is the appropriate scoped fix: changing only configuration would leave deployments without explicit PDF settings on the retired model. The existing ability to select another provider remains intact.
